name: AIAgentResponse
description: AIAgentResponse is the foundational conversational atom — a single card that wraps an AIMessageHeader (bot avatar, agent name, timestamp) above an AIMessageBody (plain-language prose). It establishes AI authorship with no extra chrome.
intent: The minimal unit of AI speech — header plus body in a branded card. Use this atom when the response stands alone with no follow-up actions or structured data.

authority.note: Imported from godesign27/agentic-ui-design-system (branch cursor/import-ai-components-6d77). Runtime TSX lives under src/components/ai/. Existing top-level shadcn ports remain authoritative for the governed AI kit.

props.name: agentLabel
props.hint: Name displayed in the attribution header.

props.name: timestamp
props.hint: Right-aligned timestamp string in the header.

props.name: children
props.hint: Body content. Use <strong> with brand color for emphasis.

props.name: dark
props.hint: Renders the response card on a deep brand-ink surface with light text — for use on dark chat chrome.

notes: Use AI tokens from ai-tokens.ts — do not hardcode brand hex.
Fetch dependency atomics from components/ai/ mirror specs.
Self-contained under components/ai/ — do not require an external AI UI package.

keyboard: Ensure keyboard focus order matches visual order

forbiddenUsage: Do not invent dependency atomics — use bundled canonical sources
Do not hardcode brand hex — use AI tokens
